title: Seam Cutter
summary_raw: Tool: Seam Cutter I built this weird and very specific cropping tool - it lets you create a horizontal or vertical cut across an image, then slide the two sides relative to each other. Effectively it lets you crop out a section in the middle of an image. I wanted this because I often use Tailor on my iPhone to stitch several screenshots together into lot long image, but sometimes I find myself wanting to crop out a section in the middle - to redact an irrelevant prompt from a transcript, for example. title: Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang
summary_raw: Tsinghua researchers released AKV, an SGLang-based serving system for cache engineering. LLM agents drop and reposition KV cache instead of summarizing history, cutting average cost 27.7% across 4 agent benchmarks. title: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time
summary_raw: Hugging Face released Carbon-X, an open 14.8B DNA language model built on Qwen3-14B.
